name: Oda Nobunaga
source:
A feared person who is called the Demon King of the Sixth Heaven.
A charismatic guy who loves new things imported from the west.
He's hard to approach, but he's loved by his retainers.
Koujirou's view: 'A man who likes teasing people'.
